class TestR04R05Edges:
    def test_invalidate_many_all_first_tag_absent(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        # first requested tag absent -> intersection empty, no mutation
        assert c.invalidate_many(['z', 'x'], mode='all') == 0
        assert len(c) == 2

    def test_invalidate_many_invalid_mode_with_empty_tags(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.invalidate_many([], mode='none')
        assert len(c) == 1 and c.get('a') == 1

    def test_invalidate_many_invalid_tags_with_valid_mode(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            c.invalidate_many('xy', mode='all')
        assert len(c) == 1 and c.get('a') == 1

    def test_invalidate_many_does_not_refresh_recency(self):
        c = TaggedCache(2)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        # invalidation of an unrelated tag must not change LRU order
        assert c.invalidate_many(['z'], mode='any') == 0
        c.put('c', 3)  # evicts LRU 'a'
        assert 'a' not in c
        assert c.get('b') == 2 and c.get('c') == 3

    def test_resize_shrink_to_zero_entries(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.resize(1)
        assert len(c) == 1
        c.resize(1)
        assert len(c) == 1

    def test_resize_shrink_all(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
        c.resize(1)
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('b') == 2  # 'b' was MRU
        assert 'a' not in c
        assert c.invalidate('x') == 0
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 1

    def test_resize_grow_then_shrink_again(self):
        c = TaggedCache(1)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.resize(3)
        c.put('b', 2)
        c.put('c', 3)
        c.resize(2)
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert 'a' not in c
        assert c.get('b') == 2 and c.get('c') == 3

    def test_resize_preserves_values_detached(self):
        c = TaggedCache(3)
        v = {'n': [1]}
        c.put('a', v)
        v['n'].append(2)  # stored copy unaffected
        c.resize(2)
        assert c.get('a') == {'n': [1]}

    def test_invalidate_many_then_resize_consistent(self):
        c = TaggedCache(4)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['y'])
        c.put('d', 4, ['y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x'], mode='any') == 2
        c.resize(1)
        assert len(c) == 1
        assert c.get('d') == 4  # MRU survivor
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 1
